node.title: E22 tail-removed quotient-factor passthrough
node.statement: If a touched-petal locator L_T divides a cofactor H, and T is the disjoint union of a tail B and full quotient fibers with locators X^{M}-z, then after removing the tail factor L_B the cofactor divisibility supplies exactly those quotient factors. Products of distinct quotient fibers pass through with their multiplicity one.
node.attack_surface: formal squarefree locator divisibility after splitting tail and quotient-fiber factors
node.falsifier: a squarefree locator factorization L_T=L_B prod_z (X^M-z) dividing H while one quotient factor fails to divide the tail-removed cofactor
